question: Where must the supreme beloved goddess be ritually established?
premises: The rite specifies a locus of placement.
The locus is the thousand-spoked great lotus.
The supreme beloved woman is the object placed there.
inference: The supreme beloved goddess must be established in the thousand-spoked great lotus.
uncertainties: Whether sahasrāra refers to a bodily center or an external diagram is not explicit.
plain_english: Having placed the supreme beloved woman in the thousand-spoked great lotus.
